findings.concern: An adapter might retain the existing hard-coded connectors as a fallback.
findings.resolution: The sole CLI requires --registry; absence/malformed registry exits 2 and no default descriptor is loaded.

findings.concern: Scoped configuration could accidentally preserve a strict witness outside its declared build/artifact bounds.
findings.resolution: OCaml-C witnesses are requalified by source root, derived Dune target and artifact root; Rust endpoints are requalified by source/build/artifact scope.

findings.concern: Callbacks could be reported as endpoints merely because a registration was selected.
findings.resolution: callback_registration is emitted solely as FRONTIER with receiver-set-not-proved.

open: The next delivery can integrate this registry-gated envelope into the aggregate FFI report and add compatibility-aware recurrence.
